recs.REC_SLEEP_H_LOW_CAUTION: You slept little ({value} h). Reduce light and noise before bed and try to sleep at your mission schedule time.
recs.REC_SLEEP_H_LOW_CRITICAL: Severely insufficient sleep ({value} h). Avoid high-risk tasks today and tell the flight surgeon.
recs.REC_SLEEP_H_HIGH_CAUTION: You slept a lot ({value} h). Keep regular hours and do some physical activity today.
recs.REC_SLEEP_H_HIGH_CRITICAL: Excessive sleep ({value} h). Tell the flight surgeon, it may indicate fatigue or mood issues.
recs.REC_MOOD_LOW_CAUTION: Your mood is low. Talk to a crewmate or your family and do an activity you enjoy.
recs.REC_MOOD_LOW_CRITICAL: Your mood is very low. Contact the flight surgeon or the crew medical officer today.
recs.REC_STRESS_HIGH_CAUTION: Your stress is elevated. Do 5 minutes of guided breathing and take a break from tasks.
recs.REC_STRESS_HIGH_CRITICAL: Your stress is very high. Contact the flight surgeon and ask for support to reduce your workload.
recs.REC_PVT_CAUTION: PVT latency elevated ({value} ms): a sign of fatigue. Rest and avoid critical tasks until you recover.
recs.REC_PVT_CRITICAL: PVT latency > 450 ms ({value} ms). High neurocognitive fatigue: defer critical tasks and rest immediately.
